recentIncidents.title: Builds paused for Free, Trial and Hobby workspaces

updates.message: Dismissed as a notice. No impact.

We have temporarily paused builds for workspaces for Free, Trial and Hobby plans. New deployments for these workspaces will stay queued until builds resume. 

Services that are already running are not affected. Builds for Pro and Enterprise workspaces are processing normally.

Builds have resumed for all workspaces and are completing normally. This incident is now resolved.

If you triggered a deploy, pushed to GitHub, or restarted a service while builds were paused, please trigger it again. Those were not queued during the pause and will not start on their own. Cron jobs scheduled during the pause did not run, and will continue from their next scheduled time.

recentIncidents.title: API degradation causing slow or stuck deployments

updates.message:
The issue affecting our API and causing slow or stuck deployments has been resolved. A period of elevated load on our API caused a backlog to build in our deployment queue faster than it could drain. We applied several fixes to improve how our deployment system handles backpressure and temporarily paused new deployments for Hobby-tier projects while the queue recovered. All deployments have since resumed and are processing normally.

We apologize for any inconvenience. If you continue to experience issues, please contact support at https://station.railway.com.

We are seeing recovery and are monitoring this incident.

Hobby deployments have been re-enabled.

We are aware of an issue affecting our API that is causing slow or stuck deployments for some users.

We are actively investigating and working to restore normal operations. We will provide updates as we learn more.
